notes.text: Abraham is widely revered as a foundational legendary figure among adherents of the eponymous Abrahamic religions.
Abraham is revered in all other Abrahamic religions, such as the Baháʼí Faith and the Druze faith.
Abraham is regarded as the common forefather of both the Arab people through his son Ishmael and the Jewish people through his son Isaac.
Abraham is remembered as a religious figure connected with Iraq.
Abraham's recorded life dates place this profile around -1813--1638.
